groups.title: Inspect authoritative science rate and recover earned output
Read shared science ledger in gallery and lab

manifests.title: Read science capacity separately from delivered output
manifests.description: Four ordinary players start a real campaign. The owner opens the private science source ledger, queues Innovation and recovers the earned new capacity separately from delivered science. Demo catalogue/admission/research clock and leased tick delivery are explicitly labelled harness controls; no stored state is injected.

steps.description: Open the real per-tick rail control on both independent accounts. Current capacity exists before the first delivered output.
steps.acknowledgement: Both authorized ledgers acknowledge tick0, current1.4 capacity and their own completed station.
verifications: The two ordinary views name different owned orbital sources, and no historical output is substituted for capacity.

steps.description: Return to the same galaxy and queue Innovation through ordinary research controls. Capacity remains1.4 until the level is earned.
steps.acknowledgement: The actual research receipt accepts Innovation for tick1.
verifications: The peer remains at its own initial rate and source while the owner order is accepted.

steps.description: Existing guarded demo clock and fifteen real leased ticks, concurrent/repeated delivery. No levels, resources or private projections injected; not hosted Scheduler certification.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Reload both accounts and inspect the earned new rate separately from tick15 output. The peer retains its independent sources and rate.
steps.acknowledgement: Authoritative tick15 supplies owner1.404 capacity while last delivered science is1.4; peer remains1.4.
verifications: Source identity and peer ownership remain isolated through reload; lower totals stay inside the reading viewport.

steps.description: Reload the existing acknowledged campaign with normal motion, open its actual science rail using Enter, then Tab into the bounded ledger. No campaign command is sent.
steps.acknowledgement: The mounted private ledger recovers the confirmed tick, current capacity and delivered output under the selected motion preference.
verifications: Authorized rates, delivered output, source ownership and accepted command state remain unchanged by local reading or motion preference.
Top basis and primary Return remain fully inside their clipping ancestors; keyboard reading does not move the game document.
Normal-motion device preference; finite effects settled without fast-forward and exact pixels unchanged.
Normal-motion device preference; finite effects settled without fast-forward and exact pixels unchanged.

steps.description: Press End in the focused ledger to read delivered science and assumptions, while the return action remains available.
steps.acknowledgement: Keyboard reading reaches the actual delivered total without changing the acknowledged rate or server facts.
verifications: Authorized rates, delivered output, source ownership and accepted command state remain unchanged by local reading or motion preference.
Delivered total and Return are contained before capture; only the bounded reading region scrolls.
Normal-motion device preference; finite effects settled without fast-forward and exact pixels unchanged.
Normal-motion device preference; finite effects settled without fast-forward and exact pixels unchanged.

steps.description: Home returns the same reading region to its basis, then Escape closes the ledger and restores its real rail opener.
steps.acknowledgement: The ledger closes and focus returns to the science resource control, without sending a command.
verifications: Authorized rates, delivered output, source ownership and accepted command state remain unchanged by local reading or motion preference.
Normal-motion device preference; finite effects settled without fast-forward and exact pixels unchanged.
Normal-motion device preference; finite effects settled without fast-forward and exact pixels unchanged.

steps.description: Reload the existing acknowledged campaign with reduced motion, open its actual science rail using Enter, then Tab into the bounded ledger. No campaign command is sent.
steps.acknowledgement: The mounted private ledger recovers the confirmed tick, current capacity and delivered output under the selected motion preference.
verifications: Authorized rates, delivered output, source ownership and accepted command state remain unchanged by local reading or motion preference.
Top basis and primary Return remain fully inside their clipping ancestors; keyboard reading does not move the game document.

steps.description: Press End in the focused ledger to read delivered science and assumptions, while the return action remains available.
steps.acknowledgement: Keyboard reading reaches the actual delivered total without changing the acknowledged rate or server facts.
verifications: Authorized rates, delivered output, source ownership and accepted command state remain unchanged by local reading or motion preference.
Delivered total and Return are contained before capture; only the bounded reading region scrolls.

steps.description: Home returns the same reading region to its basis, then Return to galaxy closes the ledger and restores its real rail opener.
steps.acknowledgement: The ledger closes and focus returns to the science resource control, without sending a command.
verifications: Authorized rates, delivered output, source ownership and accepted command state remain unchanged by local reading or motion preference.

steps.description: One real leased following tick applies the already-earned Innovation level; repeated delivery remains empty.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Recover tick16 after reload, read the actual1.404 delivery, then retain the same authoritative source and current rate.
steps.acknowledgement: The new rate is now also the actual delivered output at confirmed tick16.
verifications: Reload preserves source ownership and does not alter the accepted command identity.

manifests.title: Inspect the shared science source instrument
manifests.description: Actual ScienceLedger in reducer-derived gallery/lab specimens. This is component evidence, not live authorization. The ledger itself has no invented animation or pending science values.

steps.description: Open the actual shared ledger with Enter and read its lower totals through End.
steps.acknowledgement: The reducer-derived component distinguishes initial capacity from pending first delivery.
verifications: The actual delivered-total reading and Return remain usable inside the component.

steps.description: Open the actual shared ledger with Enter and read its lower totals through End.
steps.acknowledgement: The reducer-derived component distinguishes initial capacity from pending first delivery.
verifications: The actual delivered-total reading and Return remain usable inside the component.

steps.description: Inspect capacity at the actual lab frame using the production ledger in both comparison panels. Seek changes reducer-derived presentation, not game state.
steps.acknowledgement: Both comparison panels show the same capacity and the matching completed or pending delivery.
verifications: Normal and reduced comparison facts agree; no animation changes a science amount.
The named comparison is the keyboard reading viewpoint; its delivered total and Return remain contained before capture.
The named comparison is the keyboard reading viewpoint; its delivered total and Return remain contained before capture.

steps.description: Inspect delivered at the actual lab frame using the production ledger in both comparison panels. Seek changes reducer-derived presentation, not game state.

verifications: Normal and reduced comparison facts agree; no animation changes a science amount.
